admission_authority: TEST_ONLY_R1 exact synthetic allowlists; no migration; no native proof
change_rule: No post-B2 baseline edits. Essential defect => STOP; request a newly authorized baseline freeze.

checks.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m unittest research.ecsc_hca_r0.test_baselines research.ecsc_hca_r0.test_task -v

methods.B0: baselines.py inspector; task.predict exact bounded worklist closure
methods.B1: baselines.py inspector; task.predict weighted synchronous conjunction

ordering: R1A tests passed; B2 module not yet created or executed

resource_semantics.graph: immutable object/index cardinalities bounded; incidence entries <= min(axioms*degree,relations*arity)
resource_semantics.readout: task record slots: mandatory constraints + predictions + direct relation evidence
resource_semantics.sidecar: per-coordinate encoded bytes, scalar streaming two-pass admission, scratch <= 386 ASCII bytes for a 64-character escaped label
resource_semantics.state_bytes: B2 auxiliary activation state ceiling, checked by B2; graph capacity shared by all methods
resource_semantics.work: logical operations, not exact CPU instructions/FLOPs; wall_ns measured separately

scoring_authority: evaluation.score; harness-only withheld frozenset; synthetic retrieval not semantic truth
task_envelope: task.Task and Predicate; no withheld key or oracle field
